content.value_statement: Claude Code hook setup can be hard to structure safely. This skill provides event patterns, examples, and checklists for validation, logging, notifications, and automation.
actual_capabilities: Explains Claude Code hook events and common trigger patterns.
Provides templates for PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Notification, and Stop hooks.
Helps design validation hooks for tool execution workflows.
Shows local logging and notification hook examples.
Lists quality checks for hook speed, matchers, and error handling.
limitations: It does not install hooks automatically.
It does not verify shell commands in a live Claude Code environment.
It focuses on Claude Code hook structure, not general shell scripting.
Notification examples may need platform-specific changes.

use_cases.title: Add Validation Hooks
use_cases.description: Create a PreToolUse hook plan that checks risky Bash commands before execution.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Logging
use_cases.description: Build consistent local logging or notification hooks for team Claude Code workstations.

use_cases.title: Review Hook Safety
use_cases.description: Check hook templates for narrow matchers, fast commands, and safe handling of tool data.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple Claude Code PostToolUse hook that logs Write events locally. Explain where to place the configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Add Notifications
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Claude Code notification hook for completion alerts. Include matcher guidance and safe message handling.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Tool Use
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a PreToolUse hook design that checks Bash commands before execution. Keep the matcher narrow and explain failure behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Hook Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Claude Code hook plan for safety, speed, logging volume, matcher scope, and error handling.

output_examples.input: Create a hook for local write logging.
output_examples.output: A PostToolUse logging plan with the event, matcher, command purpose, test steps, and privacy notes.

output_examples.input: Review my Bash validation hook idea.
output_examples.output: A safety review covering matcher scope, failure behavior, command runtime, and risks from untrusted tool input.

output_examples.input: Plan notification hooks for Claude Code.
output_examples.output: A notification design with trigger choices, platform notes, short messages, and guidance for avoiding secret exposure.

best_practices: Keep matchers narrow so hooks run only for intended tools.
Test each shell command outside Claude Code before adding it.
Keep hook output short and avoid writing secrets to logs.
anti_patterns: Using a wildcard matcher when one tool matcher is enough.
Embedding secrets or tokens directly in hook commands.
Running slow or interactive commands that block Claude Code.

faq.question: Does this skill install hooks automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps design hook configurations. Users still review and add settings themselves.

faq.question: Which Claude Code events does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Notification, and Stop hook events.

faq.question: Can Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. Codex can use the guidance to draft or review Claude Code hook configurations.

faq.question: Are shell commands required?
faq.answer: Claude Code hooks use command hooks in the examples, so commands must be reviewed before use.

faq.question: Can it validate risky Bash commands?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help design PreToolUse matchers and validation commands for Bash workflows.

faq.question: Does it send data to external services?
faq.answer: No evidence found in the reviewed files. Any user-added notification command should still be checked.
